description: Disposable Hyper-V test VMs from a shared pool (vm_acquire, vm_start, vm_run, vm_read_out, vm_stop, vm_release, vm_status; pool_plan, pool_create, pool_resize, pool_remove, pool_status). Several agents at once, each run restored from a clean checkpoint, builds copied in from the project, network off by default. Needs its helper service set up once in an admin PowerShell (setup\install.ps1); every pool change is approved by the user in an admin PowerShell. Turn on only in a dedicated testing project: every agent in a project where it is on gets it. Requires Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise with Hyper-V, and Node 18+.
